listings.description: Ripple is a refined woody-aromatic fragrance inspired by cool ocean breezes and smooth woody depth. It opens with fresh bergamot, calming lavender, and aromatic sage, creating a crisp and elegant introduction. The heart flows into marine and watery accords blended with cedarwood and sandalwood, adding clean freshness with a subtle woody character. The base settles into musk, incense, and dry amber, leaving a smooth, modern, and long-lasting trail that feels effortlessly sophisticated. .

listings.rawTitle: Sultan The founder & Sultana The Joyful

listings.description: Nabatieh is a rich oriental-gourmand fragrance that blends warm spices with indulgent sweetness and smoky woods. The opening features cardamom, cinnamon, and almond, creating a spicy yet creamy introduction. The heart unfolds with dates, coffee, orris, and vanilla, delivering a deep, addictive gourmand character with elegant floral softness. The base settles into tonka bean, cedarwood, smoky notes, and akigalawood, leaving a warm, woody, and long-lasting trail that feels bold and luxurious. .

Liquid Brun – Limited Edition is a refined fougère-oriental fragrance wrapped in warm amber elegance. It opens with a fresh citrus lift blended with aromatic lavender and spicy cardamom, creating a clean yet captivating introduction. The heart reveals a smooth floral-woody balance of orange blossom, rose, and guaiacwood, adding depth and sophistication. The base settles into a rich, masculine trail of dry amber, vanilla, tonka bean, and oakmoss, delivering warmth, sensuality, and lasting presence. .

Grow is a rich and comforting woody-gourmand fragrance that blends warm spices, creamy sweetness, and refined woods. It opens with an exotic mix of saffron, date accord, davana essence, Timur pepper, and juicy pear, creating a vibrant yet indulgent introduction. The heart reveals a luscious custard date accord layered with geranium, rose, sandalwood, muguet, peony, and jasmine, adding floral elegance and creamy depth. The base settles into a deep, long-lasting trail of Atlas cedarwood, cypriol, labdanum resin, tonka absolute, vanilla, musk, dry woods, and immortelle, leaving a smooth, enveloping, and addictive signature. .

Love in Every Note - Nectare Extradose & Safari Breeze
The Extrovert x Introvert  - Liquid Brun & Spectre Ghost
Physical Touch - Royal Blend Sequoia & Liquid Brun

listings.description: Aromatix Frostbite is a vibrant and modern fragrance that fuses juicy fruits with aromatic florals and deep woody ambers. The opening bursts with mango, bergamot, blueberry, apple, and a touch of cardamom, creating a fresh yet slightly spicy introduction. The heart unfolds with lavender, pink pepper, jasmine, geranium, violet, and vetiver, adding aromatic depth and elegance. The base is rich and long-lasting, blending oakmoss, amber, ambergris, vanilla, sandalwood, cedarwood, and patchouli for a smooth, powerful, and confident finish. .

Marmara is a refined and modern fragrance that blends spicy freshness with soft, musky woods. It opens with the vibrant sparkle of Italian bergamot, accented by the warmth of black pepper and saffron. The heart reveals a smooth fusion of cashmere wood, ambroxan, and a delicate powdery accord, adding depth and elegance. The base settles into a clean and comforting trail of musk and white sandalwood, creating a sophisticated and long-lasting impression. .

Western Shisha is an intriguing oriental-spicy fragrance that blends sweet, smoky, and warm notes for a unique and captivating experience. The top notes of bubblegum grape, davana, and olibanum create a playful yet exotic opening. The heart combines jasmine, rum, and a shisha accord, adding depth, aromatic richness, and a hint of indulgence. The base of patchouli and vanilla provides a smooth, warm, and long-lasting finish that lingers seductively on the skin. .

Hypnotic Gold is a rich oriental-vanilla fragrance that entices with a blend of spicy, sweet, and floral notes. The top opens with vibrant rosemary, black pepper, saffron, and a playful hint of cotton candy. The heart unveils a luxurious mix of freesia, cinnamon, jasmine, rose, orris, and honey, adding depth and sophistication. The base of musk, cypriol, tonka, cashmere, vanilla, and styrax provides a warm, creamy, and long-lasting finish, leaving a hypnotic and memorable trail. .

Ravine Ice is a crisp and refreshing citrus-aromatic fragrance inspired by clean air and cool landscapes. It opens with a sharp burst of lemon and fresh geranium, delivering instant brightness and energy. The heart introduces aromatic sage and lavender blended with subtle salty notes, creating a modern, breezy freshness. The base of moss, cedarwood, and ambroxan adds a cool woody depth, leaving a clean, long-lasting, and effortlessly masculine trail. .

8TH WONDER is a bold and intoxicating oriental fragrance that blends spicy freshness with rich boozy sweetness and deep resins. The opening sparkles with cardamom and pink pepper, balanced by the juicy glow of glazed apple. The heart reveals an indulgent fusion of date liquor accord, davana, osmanthus absolute, and boozy notes, creating a luxurious and addictive character. The base settles into a powerful resinous trail of myrrh, styrax, patchouli, benzoin, labdanum, and amberxtrem, leaving a warm, intense, and unforgettable impression. .

Ravine Ginger is a vibrant and uplifting fragrance that blends sparkling citrus with spicy warmth and a smooth woody-amber base. The opening is fresh and energetic with ginger, lemon, and bergamot, delivering a crisp and zesty start. The heart reveals a soft floral bouquet of orange blossom, magnolia, jasmine, and rose, adding elegance and balance. The base unfolds into a comforting blend of vanilla, amber, sandalwood, cashmere woods, patchouli, and musk, leaving a warm, refined, and long-lasting trail. .

Cosmic Tonka is a luxurious oriental-woody fragrance that combines sparkling spices, rich florals, and deep warm woods. The top notes of bergamot and saffron create a bright, invigorating opening. The heart unfolds with the sophisticated blend of agarwood and Bulgarian rose, adding floral elegance and complexity. The base of white musk, tonka bean, amber, and oakmoss provides a warm, sensual, and long-lasting finish, leaving a refined and captivating trail. .

Nomad is a modern, luminous fragrance that blends fresh citrus with airy marine accords and warm ambered woods. The opening is bright and refined with lemon and saffron, creating an energetic yet elegant introduction. The heart reveals soft white flowers layered with marine notes, adding a clean, breezy sophistication. The base of vanilla, dry amber, cypriol, and patchouli brings warmth and depth, leaving a smooth, long-lasting trail that feels both free-spirited and refined. .

Aromatix Naughty Dates is a seductive woody-aromatic fragrance built around the irresistible sweetness of dates. It opens with a fresh and spicy burst of bergamot, mandarin, and cardamom. The heart reveals a rich, gourmand blend of dates, honey, ebony wood, coffee, hazelnut, and cinnamon — creating a warm, addictive, and slightly dark sweetness. The base settles into creamy vanilla, caramel, sandalwood, and amber, delivering a cozy, sensual finish that lingers beautifully on the skin. .

Obsidian is a powerful amber fragrance that blends luminous citrus with deep resinous warmth. The opening sparkles with aldehydic freshness layered over grapefruit and bergamot, creating a bright yet refined introduction. At the heart, mystical myrrh intertwines with jasmine and labdanum, adding a rich, resinous elegance. The base unfolds into a smooth and addictive blend of vanilla, amber, and tonka bean, leaving a warm, sensual trail that feels both modern and timeless. .

Nectare Extradose is a vibrant citrus-gourmand fragrance that blends zesty freshness with indulgent sweetness. It opens with a lively burst of bitter orange, ginger, and bergamot softened by neroli. The heart reveals a luxurious mix of honey, tuberose, saffron, and orange blossom, while the base of walnut milk, vanilla, and tobacco adds a creamy, addictive warmth that lingers beautifully. .

Jade is a refined musky-floral fragrance that balances subtle spice with soft elegance. It opens with a gentle spark of black pepper, adding a modern, spicy freshness. The heart blooms with luminous jasmine and powdery orris, creating a graceful floral softness. The base of musk, akigalawood, and dry amber delivers a smooth, warm finish that feels clean, sophisticated, and effortlessly chic. .

Jade Giallo is a radiant fruity-ambery fragrance that blends juicy fruits with warm, indulgent depth. It opens with a sparkling mix of mandarin, pear, bergamot, and hazelnut, creating a bright yet creamy introduction. The heart reveals a smooth and elegant blend of cashmere, jasmine, vetiver, and caramel, adding warmth and sophistication. The base settles into a sensual trail of musk, vanilla, ambergris, and moss, leaving a rich and addictive impression. .

Zenith Santal is a warm oriental-woody fragrance that exudes elegance and subtle sophistication. The top note of saffron provides a spicy, luxurious opening. The heart blends chestnut and lavender for a soft, aromatic richness. The base of vanilla, sandalwood, and cedarwood delivers a creamy, woody finish, leaving a smooth and lasting impression. .

Zenith Deep is a vibrant woody-aromatic fragrance that combines zesty citrus and fresh spices with rich, warm woods. The top notes of grapefruit, lemon, mint, bergamot, and pepper provide a bright and invigorating opening. The heart unfolds with ginger, nutmeg, jasmine, and melon, adding a lively and aromatic complexity. The base of incense, amber, cedarwood, sandalwood, and labdanum delivers a deep, smoky, and long-lasting finish, leaving a sophisticated and memorable trail. .

Safari Breeze is a refreshing fruity fragrance that captures the feeling of an open-air escape. It opens with a vibrant blend of blackcurrant, coconut, and grapefruit, delivering a juicy and tropical freshness. The heart reveals a cool touch of spearmint balanced with soft jasmine, adding an airy and uplifting character. The base of vetiver, amber, and oakmoss provides a smooth, earthy finish that grounds the fragrance with natural elegance. .

Vulcan Black Friday is a bold woody-leathery fragrance that embodies strength, depth, and timeless sophistication. The top bursts open with the warmth of saffron, crisp apple, and spicy cinnamon. At its heart, the rich essence of leather intertwines with the subtle elegance of rose. The base of papyrus, patchouli, musk, and moss adds an earthy and masculine depth, leaving a powerful, long-lasting impression. .

Aromatix Teas Me is an elegant oriental-woody fragrance that captures the warmth of spiced tea and exotic woods. It opens with a refreshing blend of lime, ginger, and teakwood that instantly awakens the senses. The heart unfolds into a sophisticated harmony of black tea, cardamom, and geranium absolu, enriched with the luminous note of hedione. The base of amber, patchouli, vanilla, tonka, and olibanum creates a smooth and sensual trail that lingers beautifully. .

Aromatix Sunkissed captures the radiant energy of a sunlit day with its refreshing woody-aromatic composition. It opens with a sparkling fusion of pomelo, bergamot, and bitter orange, bringing an instant burst of brightness. The heart reveals a playful twist of spritz and soda accords blended with tea and cardamom for a lively, modern freshness. As it settles, notes of vetiver, cedarwood, vanilla, cashmeran, and ambertonic create a smooth, comforting warmth that perfectly balances its zestful start. .

Aromatix Magnetiq is a captivating woody-aromatic fragrance that exudes elegance and modern charm. The top notes of bergamot, pink pepper, and lavender create a fresh, invigorating opening. The heart unfolds with a floral-aromatic blend of rosemary, orange blossom, neroli, iris, and musk, adding complexity and sophistication. The base of sandalwood, cedarwood, oakmoss, vanilla, myrrh, and amber provides a warm, rich, and long-lasting finish that leaves a magnetic impression. .

Iris Patchouli is an elegant oriental-floral fragrance that combines delicate florals with rich, earthy depth. The top notes of davana and cinnamon create a warm and spicy opening. The heart unfolds with the powdery softness of violet flower and iris accord, adding sophistication and elegance. The base of leather, olibanum, patchouli, and benzoin provides a deep, long-lasting, and luxurious finish, leaving a memorable impression. .

Aromatix Forbidden Fruit is an indulgent oriental-floral fragrance that balances zesty freshness with fruity sweetness and warm depth. The top notes of bergamot, blood orange, and cardamom create a sparkling and invigorating opening. The heart blooms with juicy red apple, margarita, peach, and rose, adding a playful and sophisticated fruity-floral character. The base of vanilla absolute, benzoin, amber, sandalwood, cedarwood, and musk provides a warm, creamy, and long-lasting finish that lingers seductively. .

Embrace timeless sophistication with Chronicles, an oriental-woody fragrance designed for men who appreciate depth and refinement. It begins with the resinous warmth of myrrh, the brightness of elemi, and the subtle spice of pink peppercorn. The heart reveals a smooth blend of heliotrope, powdery iris, and smoky frankincense, adding richness and character. Finally, the scent lingers with a warm and comforting base of tonka bean, creamy vanilla, and sensual musk. Crafted to last up to 12 hours, Chronicles is versatile, youthful, and refreshing — perfect for both everyday wear and special occasions. .

Amber Empire is a luxurious oriental-amber fragrance that radiates warmth, richness, and sensual sophistication. The top opens with a smooth blend of oriental accords, cashmere wood, vanilla wood, and a hint of liquorous sweetness. The heart reveals elegant cedarwood, golden amber, and cane sugar, creating a luminous depth. The base of musk, tonka beans, labdanum, and sandalwood leaves a creamy, long-lasting trail of refined opulence. .
Earthy patchouli blended with floral jasmine sambac, enveloped in a smoky, mystical incense. .

This fragrance opens with a warm, spicy richness of saffron, cardamom, and cumin, creating an exotic and opulent first impression. At its heart, the soft floral elegance of damask rose blends with the earthy, slightly smoky depth of cypriol oil, adding mystery and sensuality. The base is smooth and enveloping, with creamy sandalwood, velvety musk, and sweet tonka bean, uplifted by the modern amber-like radiance of ambroxan and the grounding strength of cedar. The overall scent is luxurious, warm, and deeply alluring — a perfect balance of spice, floral sophistication, and woody intensity. .
A fresh burst of citrus and herbs, blending into a green, woody heart with hints of floral sweetness, and finishing with a smooth, slightly sweet, and resinous base. .
Bright and fresh like sliced grapefruit with a touch of sea breeze, ending subtly woody. .

Veneno Bianco is a floral-ambery creation that embodies sophistication and warmth. It opens with a refreshing combination of bergamot, neroli, and milk, offering a creamy citrus introduction. The heart blooms with the exotic essence of tiare flower, ylang-ylang, and delicate white florals, evoking elegance and grace. A sensual dry-down of coconut, vanilla, guaiac wood, and labdanum leaves a soft yet lasting trail, making it the perfect signature scent for those who embrace timeless beauty. .

Fierte Luna is a sophisticated Citrus Gourmand fragrance that balances freshness, warmth, and sweetness. It opens with sparkling notes of lavender, bergamot, and zesty lemon, creating an uplifting and invigorating impression. The heart introduces a harmonious blend of golden honey, spicy cinnamon, delicate jasmine, and soft cashmeran, adding depth and elegance. Finally, the fragrance rests on a rich, comforting base of creamy vanilla, aromatic tobacco leaf, and sweet tonka bean, leaving a long-lasting, captivating trail. Fierte Luna is perfect for those who love a fragrance that is both bright and indulgent, offering a unique, refined signature scent. .

Step into a world of indulgence with An Equestrian Series Olena, a delightful floral-fruity-gourmand scent. It opens with a fresh medley of bergamot, grapefruit, mandarin, and orange, delivering a burst of citrusy brightness. As the scent unfolds, a heart of orange blossom, raspberry, and blackcurrant adds a sweet and juicy allure. The base is irresistibly comforting, featuring marshmallow, cream, musk, and ambrette, leaving behind a soft and velvety embrace. Perfect for those who crave a balance of freshness and warmth. .

Mythical Gryphon is a captivating Oriental Spicy fragrance designed for those who crave intensity and sophistication. The scent opens with a striking blend of pepper, saffron, cardamom, and bergamot, creating an exotic and invigorating introduction. At its heart, floral rose intertwines with the smoky, woody richness of akigalawood, bark, cedarwood, and a hint of cinnamon, adding depth and intrigue. The fragrance finally rests on a luxurious base of creamy vanilla, earthy vetiver, rich patchouli, and warm amber, leaving a long-lasting, powerful trail. Mythical Gryphon is a majestic scent, combining spice, woods, and sensuality into a memorable and daring fragrance experience. .

Catch yourself in the limelight with the luxurious scent of Miraj Exclusif by French Avenue. The spicy warmth of Cardamom is seamlessly balanced with the rich, aromatic notes of Coffee at the beginning. The floral elegance of Jasmine Sambac adds a touch of exotic sweetness, while the green, resinous scent of Fir provides a fresh and earthy contrast at the heart. The base notes of Miraj Exclusif deliver a deep and lasting impression with a luxurious combination of Tahitian Vanilla, Laotian Oud, and Incense. The creamy sweetness of Tahitian Vanilla is enriched by the dark, woody richness of Laotian Oud, while the smoky, mystical aroma of Incense adds an element of timeless sophistication. .

Miraj Absolu by French Avenue will have you absolutely sweeped off your feet. Crafted for those who seek depth and elegance, this luxurious scent is perfect for the cooler seasons of winter and fall. The vibrant and refreshing combination of top notes awakens the senses with its sweet, citrusy, and aquatic nuances, creating a sparkling introduction. At the heart, the animalic hint of Civet adds an exotic and seductive touch, while the floral elegance of Geranium, Rose, Gardenia, and Water Lily creates a lush and romantic middle layer. At the base, the warm, woody tones of Guaiac Wood and Laotian Oud are enriched by the creamy sweetness of Vanilla and the bold richness of Coffee. Sandalwood and Indonesian Patchouli Leaf add a smooth, earthy depth, while Amber, Oakmoss, and Pink Pepper contribute a touch of warmth and spice. .

Arsh – A Fresh Citrus-Woody Delight Experience the refreshing elegance of Arsh, a vibrant blend of citrus and woody notes. The fragrance opens with the zesty brightness of grapefruit and bergamot, leading to a delicate heart of almond and neroli. The scent settles into a smooth, earthy base of vetiver and musk, creating a balanced and sophisticated aroma. Perfect for any occasion, Arsh is a crisp, uplifting fragrance that leaves a lasting impression of refined freshness. .

El Dorado is an exquisite blend of contrasts, where the warmth of mandarin and the spice of nutmeg and cumin meet the sweetness of caramel. At its heart, the delicate floral notes of violet intertwine with luxurious saffron and creamy milky accords, all enhanced by the unique depth of ambroxan. The fragrance is anchored by a rich base of leathery accord, earthy moss, and the sensual allure of white musk, oud, vanilla, and the distinctive complexity of akigalawood, creating a scent that is both bold and captivating. .

Offering a vibrant blend of spicy and woody accords complemented by citrus freshness, Spicy Amber by French Avenue is a unique creation. The dynamic top notes of baie rose, incense, and coffee opens the fragrance.Baie rose, also known as pink pepper, introduces a spicy and aromatic kick, while incense adds a touch of mystique with its resinous and smoky aroma. The addition of coffee brings depth and richness, invoking images of freshly brewed espresso and awakening the senses with its bold character. At the heart you are greeted with a refined blend of cashmere wood, cedarwood, and balsam. Cashmere wood exudes a creamy and luxurious quality, while cedarwood offers a woody and aromatic depth. Balsam adds a hint of sweetness, evoking the cozy warmth of a forest retreat. In the base notes, Spicy Amber unveils a blend of Vetiver, Vanilla, Musk, Dry Woods. Vetiver lends an earthy and smoky nuance, grounding the composition with its rugged elegance, while vanilla adds a creamy sweetness, enhancing the overall richness of the fragrance. Musk provides a subtle sensuality, lingering on the skin like a whispered caress, while dry woods add a touch of sophistication and depth. .

Indulge in the opulent sensory journey of "Saffron Elixir," a fragrance that transcends time and space with its intricate blend of spices and amber accords. At the forefront of this aromatic masterpiece are the captivating top notes of saffron and cardamom. Saffron, with its exotic allure and rich history, adds a vibrant and intoxicating warmth, while cardamom infuses the composition with its spicy and aromatic facets, evoking images of bustling spice markets and distant lands. the heart notes reveal a sumptuous blend of caramel and amber. Caramel lends a luscious sweetness, reminiscent of indulgent confections, while amber adds a deep, resinous richness that envelops the wearer in a luxurious embrace. Finally, the base notes of oak moss, sandalwood, and incense anchor the fragrance with a sense of depth and sophistication. Oak moss provides an earthy greenness, grounding the composition in nature's embrace, while sandalwood adds a creamy smoothness and a touch of exoticism. Incense lends a mystical quality, weaving an ethereal veil of smoke and spirituality that lingers in the air long after the wearer has passed. .
A rich and spicy scent with a smoky, resinous edge, blending saffron's warmth with the earthiness of birch tar and the depth of oud and benzoin. .

Introducing Moonstone Bleu by French Avenue, an enchanting fragrance that embodies the mystique and elegance of a moonlit night. Inspired by the iridescent glow of moonstone, this captivating scent captures the essence of tranquility and sophistication. At first spritz, "Moonstone Bleu" unveils a mesmerizing blend of metallic notes and aldehydes, creating a modern and ethereal opening. The spicy allure of cardamom and black pepper intertwines with watery notes and violet leaf, evoking the serene beauty of moonlit waters.As the fragrance unfolds, a heart of lavender and beeswax unfolds, enveloping you in a soothing embrace reminiscent of a tranquil night under the stars. Leather adds a touch of rugged elegance, while lime and cyclamen infuse the composition with freshness and romance. In the depths of the night, "Moonstone Bleu" reveals its true essence with a base of oakmoss and honey, grounding the fragrance in earthy warmth. Woody notes and amber create a sense of depth and sensuality, while tonka bean, patchouli, vanilla, and white musk leave a lingering trail of seduction and allure.Elegantly packaged in a wayy that is reminiscent of the moon's ethereal glow, Moonstone Bleu is the perfect accessory for those seeking sophistication and refinement. .

An extoic floral journey awaits you with Exotic Rose from French Avenue, a captivating fragrance that beckons with its luxurious blend of floral and amber accords, creating an olfactory journey that is both enchanting and alluring. At the top you find the notes of saffron and pepper. Saffron infuses the composition with its exotic and aromatic richness, while pepper adds a subtle hint of spice. At the heart the scent of rose is timeless and romantic, evoking images of lush gardens and passionate embraces. Exotic Rose reveals its sensual and seductive side at the base. Ciste, also known as rock rose, adds a resinous sweetness, enhancing the floral bouquet with its warm and balsamic aroma. Patchouli provides a grounding presence, its earthy and musky facets intertwining with the sweetness of ciste to create a rich and captivating dry down. .

Firestorm is an alluring oriental-spicy creation that opens with the aromatic warmth of cardamom, the exotic richness of davana, and the crisp sweetness of red apple. At its heart, smoky olibanum intertwines with the romantic depth of rose, adding both mystery and elegance. The base unfolds into a rich, long-lasting blend of creamy vanilla, resinous myrrh, and warm dry amber, leaving a trail that is powerful, sensual, and unforgettable. A scent made for those who thrive in intensity and allure. .

Thunder is a powerful woody-oriental creation that ignites the senses with the vibrant spice of pink pepper and elemi, softened by aromatic lavender and the crisp brightness of bergamot. The heart unveils a refined blend of powdery iris, smooth vanilla milk, and fresh geranium, adding both elegance and warmth. As it settles, earthy vetiver, robust cedarwood, and the subtle sweetness of tonka bean create a lasting, magnetic trail. Strong, confident, and sophisticated, a fragrance that leaves an unforgettable impression. .

Fierte is a bold, spicy scent with lively black and pink pepper, softened by a rich fusion of olibanum and saffron. It finishes with smooth bourbon vanilla, suede, and cedar, creating a refined, elegant aroma. .

Moonstone Noire by French Avenue exudes the mysterious allure of the night. At the forefront of "Moonstone Noire" are the soft addictive smoky top notes, enveloping you in a veil of irresistible allure from the very first spritz. With time, the heart notes of cedarwood, vetiver, and balms emerge, adding depth and complexity to the composition. Cedarwood lends a sense of warmth and earthiness, while vetiver brings a touch of rugged masculinity. Balms infuse the scent with a subtle sweetness, creating a harmonious balance that captivates the senses. In the end, Vanilla, ambernat, leather saffiano, and white oud accord combine to create a rich and sensual aroma that lingers on the skin. Vanilla adds a creamy sweetness, while ambernat provides warmth and depth. Leather saffiano lends a luxurious touch while White oud accord adds an exotic and mysterious twist. Embrace the mystery of the night with Moonstone Noire and let your inner allure shine bright. .

Zenith Blue is a refreshing aromatic-fougère fragrance that opens with the sparkling brightness of bergamot and the resinous clarity of elemi. The heart unfolds with the green elegance of geranium, the subtle heat of pepper, and the calming touch of lavender. Finally, a sophisticated base of earthy patchouli, smoky vetiver, and modern ambroxan creates a clean yet powerful trail. Dynamic, uplifting, and effortlessly refined, Zenith Blue captures the essence of confidence in motion. .

The Sultan Collection Is Inspired By The Grand Legacy Of The Ottoman Empire. Sultan - The Conquerer Is A Spicy Aromatic Ambery Fragrance That Is Extremely Long Lasting And Perfect For All Special Occasions. .
A mix of spicy citrus, sweet tobacco, and a leathery touch, settling into a blend of rich woods for a bold, complex scent. .

Veneno Scarlet is an indulgent oriental-gourmand composition that opens with the irresistible sweetness of strawberry, blackberry, and caramel, evoking pure temptation from the first breath. The heart reveals a tantalizing mix of raspberry, aromatic cedarwood, and a hint of cinnamon, adding warmth and depth. As it settles, the fragrance wraps the senses in a luxurious embrace of supple leather, creamy vanilla, tonka bean, earthy patchouli, and fresh fir. Rich, seductive, and unforgettable, a scent for those who love to leave a lingering, delicious impression. .
A Bold, Leathery Scent With A Zesty Kick From Mandarin And Bergamot, Softened By Suede And Pink Berries, And A Lingering Hint Of Vanilla And Musk. .

Inej is a captivating fragrance that opens with the rich warmth of spiced rum and the luscious sweetness of ripe peach, intertwined with the exotic touch of saffron and cardamom. As it evolves, the scent reveals a heart of Virginia cedar, dried fruits, and a hint of cinnamon, creating a balance of woody and sweet notes, enhanced by the unique presence of mineral and immortelle. The base lingers with the deep, earthy richness of Atlas cedar and patchouli, softened by the creamy sweetness of vanilla and tonka bean, all wrapped in the resinous depth of labdanum. This fragrance is a harmonious blend of warm spices and woods, leaving a trail that is both bold and alluring. .

Grecia is an enchanting fragrance that evokes elegance and warmth. It opens with the soft, milky embrace of Lait and the delicate muskiness of Ambrette, creating a smooth and inviting introduction. The heart blooms with an intoxicating floral duo of Tuberose and Jasmine, their luminous essence deepened by the mysterious allure of Incense. As the scent settles, a sumptuous base unfolds, where creamy Vanilla and sensual Musk intertwine with the comforting sweetness of Tonka Bean and the rich, velvety depth of Cacao. Grecia is a refined, sophisticated fragrance that lingers beautifully, leaving a memorable and irresistible trail. .

Muse Parfum opens with a bright and effervescent blend of aldehydes, bergamot, and tangerine, creating an invigorating and citrusy first impression. As it develops, the heart reveals a bouquet of white flowers, exuding a fresh and jasmine-infused floral elegance. The scent then settles into a warm and comforting base of dry woods, vanilla, musk, and sandalwood, leaving a lingering, soft, and sophisticated trail that beautifully balances its floral and amber facets. .
A rich blend of sweet blackcurrant and fresh florals, deepened by earthy oud and incense, creating a mysterious and alluring aroma. .

Light Up Your Nights With Lumiere Where Spicy Black Pepper And Fresh Basil Mix With Sweet Dates, Creating A Warm, Woody Scent Anchored By Rich Amber, Incense, And Smooth Sandalwood. Cherry On The Cake? The Unique Bottle Design. .

Inspired By 007 James Bond, Spectre Wraith Is Intoxicatingly Sweet With A Hint Of Spice. It Combines The Warmth Of Rum, The Richness Of Coffee, And The Sweetness Of Sugarcane, Creating A Captivating Scent That Lingers With A Touch Of Earthiness. .

Ighwa is an elegant fragrance from the Chypre family, embodying a refined balance of warmth and sophistication. It opens with a vibrant burst of mandarin, coriander seed, and pink pepper, creating a fresh yet spicy introduction. The heart reveals a rich blend of rose, cedarwood, patchouli, and violet leaves, adding depth and complexity. As it dries down, the base notes of vanilla, leather, moss, Amber Xtreme, and musk emerge, leaving a long-lasting, luxurious trail that exudes both strength and sensuality. Ighwa is a captivating scent, perfect for those who appreciate timeless elegance with a modern twist. .

Zenith Tobacco is a captivating oriental scent that opens with the fresh zest of mandarin and the decadent richness of chocolate. The heart reveals a sweet and smooth blend of honey and caramel, perfectly balanced by the earthy depth of patchouli. As it dries down, warm tolu balsam, moss, and creamy tonka beans create a comforting and indulgent base. This fragrance is perfect for those who appreciate a refined yet cozy aroma that lingers with irresistible warmth. .

An Equestrian Series Pierce is a woody-fruity fragrance that embodies both energy and elegance. It begins with an invigorating burst of neroli, bergamot, and grapefruit, awakening the senses with a citrusy brightness. The heart unveils a refined mix of geranium, clary sage, and elemi, adding aromatic depth and complexity. The scent lingers with a rich and grounding base of cashmere, ambergris, and vetiver, making it the perfect balance of fresh, woody, and sophisticated. .
Bergamot And Cardamom Kick It Off, Then It's Nutty With Pistachio And Peanut, All Wrapped In Sweet Vanilla, Honey, And A Hint Of Spice From Saffron. .

Mystic Leather from French Avenue is an enigmatic fragrance that belongs to the Leather fragrance family, evoking an aura of mystery and allure. Crafted with a masterful blend of notes, it unfolds like a captivating story, weaving together the richness of leather with woody nuances and exotic spices. Embark on a sensory journey with Mystic Leather, where the intoxicating scent of woods and incense wood entwine in the top notes, creating an intriguing and smoky introduction. Guaiacwood adds a rustic depth, while saffron lends an exotic touch, setting the stage for the enigmatic tale that unfolds. As the fragrance develops, the heart notes reveal a velvety blend of violet and leathery accord, reminiscent of supple leather warmed by the touch of the skin. Dry amber adds a subtle sweetness, like the lingering memory of an ancient ritual, while sugar cane infuses a hint of freshness and intrigue. In the depths of the base notes, Mystic Leather reveals its true essence. Patchouli, with its earthy and aromatic facets, anchors the fragrance with a sense of groundedness, while smoked wood adds a touch of mystery and allure. Sandalwood provides a creamy smoothness, rounding out the composition with a whisper of exoticism. Let Mystic Leather be your guide as you venture into the realm of the unknown, a fragrant companion on your quest for discovery and enlightenment. .
Soft, Fruity Florals Mingle With A Hint Of Citrus, Settling Into A Cozy, Sweet Finish. .

Grecia Rossa is a luxurious Oriental-Gourmand fragrance crafted for those who desire both sweetness and depth. It opens with a playful burst of strawberry, blackberry, and rich caramel, instantly drawing you in with its mouthwatering allure. The heart reveals a sophisticated twist, where ripe raspberry mingles with warm cedarwood and a touch of spicy cinnamon, creating a perfect balance between fruity brightness and woody warmth. As it settles, the fragrance unveils its true richness — a sensual base of smooth leather, creamy vanilla, tonka bean, earthy patchouli, and fir. The result is a long-lasting, addictive scent that is both bold and comforting, making Grecia Rossa a statement of elegance and passion. .
A sweet, fruity blend with a touch of freshness from bergamot, wrapped in a cozy, vanilla-infused amber and musk blend, accented by hints of woody notes. .

Zenith Vanilla is a luxurious oriental-vanilla creation that begins with the zesty sparkle of bergamot and candied orange, enriched by the deep, smooth warmth of dark rum. At its heart, delicate jasmine, smoky styrax, and powdery violet add elegance and depth. The fragrance settles into a decadent base of creamy vanilla, golden benzoin, and earthy patchouli, leaving behind a trail that is both comforting and irresistibly sophisticated. A scent made for those who want their presence to linger long after they’ve left the room. .

Ighwa By Night is a captivating Woody Spicy fragrance that embodies strength, mystery, and allure. The scent opens with an intoxicating blend of smoky tobacco, sharp pepper, and warm cinnamon, creating an instantly magnetic impression. At its heart, creamy tonka bean fuses with nutmeg and resinous labdanum, adding depth and sophistication. The fragrance finally settles into a sensual base of earthy vetiver, smooth vanilla, and papyrus, leaving a long-lasting, elegant trail. Rich, warm, and irresistibly refined, Ighwa By Night is crafted for those who desire a fragrance as bold and unforgettable as the night itself. .

Experience the zestful energy of Pinnace Oryn, a refreshing citrus fragrance that brightens every moment. It opens with a lively blend of bergamot, orange, and mandarin, delivering a burst of freshness. At its heart, the warm spice of ginger adds a dynamic twist, while the base of ambergris provides a smooth, elegant finish.Pinnace Oryn is the perfect choice for those who love crisp, invigorating scents that exude effortless sophistication. .

The Sultan Collection Is Inspired By The Grand Legacy Of The Ottoman Empire. Sultan - The Founder Is Intensely Rich, With A Mix Of Spicy Oriental Notes, Deep Oud, And Earthy Patchouli Upfront, Followed By A Warm Amber And Wood Blend, And A Dry-Down Of Resinous Labdanum And A Touch Of Animalic Civet. .

Axis is a refined Oriental Woody fragrance that strikes the perfect balance between softness and depth. It begins with a luminous touch of freesia and the juicy richness of plum, offering a subtle yet inviting opening. The heart unfolds into golden amber and warm woody accords, adding richness and character. Finally, the scent lingers with the creamy sweetness of vanilla and the resinous depth of labdanum, leaving behind a smooth, elegant trail. Both comforting and sophisticated, Axis is a timeless fragrance designed to captivate with its understated allure. .

Inspired by the strength and elegance of equestrian artistry, An Equestrian Series Haydan is a woody-aromatic fragrance crafted for the modern connoisseur. It opens with the crisp freshness of bergamot, clary sage, and lavender, setting the tone for a sophisticated experience. The heart introduces cedarwood, praline, and saffron, creating a luxurious balance between spice and warmth. Finally, the fragrance settles into a leather, musk, patchouli, vetiver, and oud accord, leaving a refined and commanding impression. .

To The Capital City Of Lebanon, Diwani Beirut Is Where A Spicy, Fruity Opening Fades Into A Woody Heart With A Touch Of Floral Sweetness, Settling Into A Smooth Blend Of Creamy Sandalwood, Resinous Benzoin, And A Hint Of Clean Musk. .

Chaos Extrait is an intense leathery composition that opens with the mouthwatering sweetness of cherry and ripe red fruits, instantly drawing the senses in. At its heart, the soft powdery elegance of iris adds refinement and balance to the richness. As it dries down, earthy moss and supple leather merge with smooth vanilla, creating a scent that is both bold and sophisticated. Distinctive and unapologetic, Chaos Extrait is made for those who command attention without saying a word. .

Dare to be unforgettable with Veneno, a spicy-oriental masterpiece that exudes mystery and power. The opening bursts with apple, cinnamon, and smoky accords, creating a tantalizing warmth. As it develops, the heart reveals tobacco and moss, adding depth and intrigue. The fragrance lingers with an intoxicating base of bourbon vanilla and orcanox, ensuring an unforgettable presence that captivates and entices. .

A tribute to classic femininity, An Equestrian Series Della is a floral fragrance that exudes elegance and charm. The opening dazzles with a juicy and tart mix of lychee, rhubarb, and bergamot, offering a refreshing and slightly tangy start. The heart blossoms with a romantic bouquet of muguet, rose, and peony, creating a soft and graceful floral harmony. The base unfolds into a comforting and sensual blend of vanilla, cashmere woods, and musk, ensuring a lasting impression of sophistication and warmth. .

Inspired by the Greek Goddess of Rainbow, Iris, Irida brings a spectrum of scents to the senses. Sweet cherry and spicy ginger upfront, followed by a lush floral burst of jasmine, settling into a warm and subtly spicy mix of amber, pink pepper, and musk. .

Venus De Milo is a graceful and enchanting Oriental-Vanilla fragrance that celebrates soft femininity with a touch of indulgence. It begins with a luminous burst of sweet orange and juicy pear nectar, delicately wrapped in rich caramel. The heart reveals a dreamy floral bouquet of white flowers, milky accord, lily of the valley, and white jasmine, offering a comforting yet sophisticated feel. As it settles, the fragrance embraces you in a warm and creamy base of Madagascar vanilla, airy ambroxan, resinous benzoin, and a gentle veil of musk. Venus De Milo is the perfect scent for those who adore soft, sensual sweetness with an elegant floral charm. .

A bold ambery-woody-spicy fragrance that begins with a striking blend of bergamot, incense, basil, and cardamom. The heart reveals a rich fusion of lavender, tobacco, and fenugreek, adding depth and intrigue. A warm, resinous base of amber dry, oud, Peru balsam, and tonka bean creates a powerful and lasting impression. .

Amber Saffron is a luxurious fragrance that captures the essence of opulence and warmth. It opens with a vibrant blend of citrus, fruity, and green notes, infused with a hint of mint and spicy saffron. The heart reveals a floral bouquet of carnation, lily of the valley, rose, and jasmine, creating a delicate and sophisticated aroma. The base is rich and sensual, featuring amber, balsamic, musk, oud, patchouli, tonka, and woody notes, leaving a lingering, mesmerizing trail that embodies timeless elegance. .

A Tribute To The Capital City Of Morocco, Diwani Rabat Unveils An Aromatic Fougère Symphony, Where The Vivacious Dance Of Grapefruit, Peach, And Blackcurrant In The Opening Notes Invites You To Embrace The Sun-Drenched Spirit Of Summer. .
Fresh and zesty citrus blended with a cool minty touch, finishing with a clean, musky allure. Experience the pinnacle of luxury and refinement with Pinnace. .
Sultry Woods Is A Refreshing Blend Of Citrusy Bergamot, Herbal Lavender, And Woody Cedar, With A Hint Of Sweet Praline And A Touch Of Musky Leather For A Confident And Masculine Aroma. .
Diwani Cairo Is An Ode To The Rich Cultural Heritage Of The Capital City Of Egypt. It Is A Tantalizing Blend Of Fruity, Floral, And Warm Notes, Perfect For The Winter Season. .

Chocola Addict is a luxurious fragrance that captivates with its irresistible blend of citrus and chocolate. The opening bursts with zesty tangerine, perfectly complementing the richness of dark chocolate. As it develops, smoky incense and sensual leather add depth and intrigue. The scent settles into a warm, velvety base of vanilla and myrrh, creating an addictive, long-lasting aroma that is both indulgent and sophisticated. .

Enigma Deux is a sophisticated Woody Aromatic fragrance that exudes mystery and refinement. The scent opens with a luxurious blend of cognac, spicy cinnamon, and juicy plum, creating a bold and inviting first impression. The heart unveils the elegant, powdery aroma of iris combined with the deep, resinous warmth of myrrh, adding depth and intrigue. Finally, the fragrance rests on a smooth and comforting base of creamy vanilla, rich tonka bean, and soft sandalwood, leaving a long-lasting, captivating trail. Enigma Deux is perfect for those who appreciate a fragrance that is both powerful and refined, balancing spice, wood, and sweet sophistication. .
Pinnace Noir embraces you in a mix of fresh apple and citrus with a spicy kick from cinnamon and cloves, settling into a woody blend of cedar and sandalwood with a hint of creamy sweet vanilla..

Unleash the fire within with Vulcan Feu, a powerful oriental-woody fragrance that commands attention. It opens with a dynamic fusion of ginger, mango, lemon, and rhubarb, creating a zesty and fruity introduction. The heart unfolds with an intoxicating bouquet of jasmine, violet, praline, and pink pepper, adding depth and sophistication. Finally, the base settles into a warm and sensual blend of cedarwood, ambergris, tonka beans, and moss, leaving behind an irresistible trail of bold confidence. .
A spicy, rosy bloom entwined with a hint of citrus freshness, settling into a soft, vanilla-infused amber warmth. .

listings.rawTitle: Royal Blend Bourbon Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Experience the luxurious depth of Royal Blend Bourbon, a bold spicy-oriental fragrance crafted for connoisseurs of refined scents. It begins with a striking blend of cinnamon bark LMR, peppermint, and basil oil, creating an invigorating and aromatic opening. The heart unfolds into an exquisite fusion of bourbon and lavender oil LMR, adding a smooth, herbaceous warmth. Finally, the base settles into a rich and woody composition of oakwood CO2 LMR and Peru balsam oil LMR, leaving a lasting impression of opulence and sophistication. Perfect for those who appreciate timeless elegance with a modern twist. .
A spicy and citrusy blend softened by floral sweetness and enriched with a complex depth of earthy, woody notes, leaving a captivating and rich aroma. .

Lumiere Elle, With Its Luminous Blend Of Fruity, Floral, And Woody Notes, Is Your Trusted Plus One For Any Occasion. Citrusy Fruits Mix With Floral Sweetness, Settling Into A Soft, Slightly Musky Warmth. Cherry On The Cake? The Unique Bottle Design. .

A luxurious oriental-floral fragrance that opens with a vibrant blend of cassis, lychee, and mandarin. The heart blooms with jasmine, water lily, and peony, adding an elegant touch. A warm and sensual base of patchouli, moss, praline, and musk leaves a lasting, sophisticated impression. .

Vulcan Sable is a fragrance of power and allure, embodying warmth and sophistication. It opens with an enticing fusion of Whiskey, Coriander Seed, and the bright zest of Mandarin and Orange, creating an intriguing contrast between smooth richness and vibrant freshness. The heart reveals a sensual interplay of Cashmeran, Anise, and Styrax, adding depth and an enigmatic touch. As it dries down, the fragrance settles into a luxurious base of creamy Vanilla, resinous Benzoin, and earthy Patchouli, leaving an addictive, long-lasting impression. Vulcan Sable is a statement of confidence, mystery, and refined seduction. .
A zesty burst of citrus mingled with spicy ginger and warm cinnamon, settling into a rich, woody tea-like fragrance that's refreshing and comforting. .

listings.rawTitle: Royal Blend Vintage Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Step into a world of refined luxury with Royal Blend Vintage, an exquisite Oriental-Fougère composition that harmonizes rich, warm notes with a touch of intrigue. The fragrance opens with the luscious sweetness of davana and plum, offering a fruity yet slightly boozy introduction. At its heart,immortelle brings a golden, honeyed warmth, adding a distinctive depth to the scent. As it evolves, the fragrance settles into a sensual, long-lasting base of vanilla, tolu balsam, and tobacco, blending creamy sweetness with resinous warmth and a smoky, sophisticated finish. Royal Blend Vintage is an ode to classic refinement, designed for those who appreciate timeless, distinguished aromas. .

listings.rawTitle: Royal Blend Nero Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Citrusy Zest Meets Sweet Vanilla Warmth, Mingling With A Hint Of Spice And A Woody Touch For A Delightful, Inviting Scent, Creating What We Call The Royal Blend Nero. .

listings.rawTitle: Royal Blend Sequoia Extrait De Parfum 100ml
listings.description: Royal Blend Sequoia is an opulent floral-fruity-gourmand that opens with the juicy vibrance of raspberry, elevated by the deep warmth of fine liquor and smooth cognac. The heart reveals an elegant pairing of romantic rose and earthy moss, lending both sophistication and freshness. As it dries down, the fragrance settles into a luxurious base of sweet praline, robust oak, and creamy sandalwood, creating a scent that is rich, warm, and irresistibly distinguished. Perfect for those who appreciate a harmonious balance of sweetness and depth. .

Sh’mallow Fluff is a joyful floriental-gourmand creation that opens with a burst of bright lemon, crisp apple, juicy strawberry jam, and the tropical smoothness of coconut. At its heart, delicate orange blossom and jasmine are wrapped in the pillowy sweetness of marshmallow, creating an irresistible candy-like charm. The fragrance lingers with a warm, comforting base of vanilla, musk, ambrox, and indulgent praline, leaving behind a trail that is both playful and enchanting. A deliciously whimsical scent for those who embrace their sweet side. .

Inspired By The Charishma And Sex Appeal Of 007 James Bond, Spectre Ghost Has A Spicy, Fresh Start With A Hint Of Citrus, Leading To A Sweet, Floral Heart And Settling Into A Warm, Comforting Blend With A Touch Of Muskiness. .

Sultana The Joyful is a vibrant Oriental-Floral fragrance that radiates happiness and elegance. It opens with a bright, juicy blend of bergamot, passion fruit, and peach, creating an uplifting and inviting first impression. The heart reveals a luxurious fusion of jasmine, geranium, and sweet caramel, adding floral sophistication and gourmand warmth. Finally, the fragrance settles into a sensual base of earthy patchouli, rich ambergris, and soft white musk, leaving a long-lasting, captivating trail. Perfect for those who love a cheerful yet refined scent, Sultana The Joyful is a harmonious celebration of fruit, floral, and warm oriental notes. .

Coconut Leche is a bold yet creamy fragrance that blends the tropical allure of toasted coconut with the floral elegance of tuberose. As it deepens, sensual leather adds depth and sophistication, while vanilla and benzoin provide a smooth, resinous warmth. A unique fusion of creamy and bold elements, perfect for those who love a modern take on coconut. .

Tropical And Sweet, Like A Sun-Kissed Garden With Ripe Mangoes, Delicate Chamomile, And A Hint Of Creamy Coconut, All Wrapped In A Warm, Vanilla-Amber Embrace, Tropical Kiss Is What You Wouldn'T Want To Miss. .

Exotic And Spicy With A Fruity Twist, This Fragrance Evokes A Sophisticated Blend Of Zesty Bergamot, Crisp Apple, And Luscious Plum, Deepening Into A Warm Embrace Of Clary Sage, Pepper, And Leather, Finally Settling Into A Sensuous Base Of Vanilla, Patchouli, Musk, And A Hint Of Sweet Pink Berries. .

Liquid Brun is our creative take on the most popular Woody note of Vanilla, where the essence of Vanilla is taken up a notch higher with a blend of spicy citrus and cinnamon. The right balance of sweet and spice. .
Rich and earthy violet leaf blends with a dark, smoky currant, finishing with a deep mix of resinous and woody notes for an intriguing, intense scent, that is Azzure Aoud. .

Discover the essence of elegance with Cocoa Morado, a masterful blend of oriental-woody notes that captivate the senses. The fragrance opens with a warm and spicy medley of cinnamon, saffron, cardamom, ginger, and pink pepper, creating an inviting first impression. At its heart, rich notes of dates, oud, incense, myrrh, and davana add depth and intrigue, while the base unfolds into a velvety embrace of vanilla, tonka bean, leather, patchouli, and labdanum, enhanced by the earthy touch of mate. .

Royal Blend is a sophisticated Woody Aromatic fragrance that exudes mystery and refinement. The scent opens with a luxurious blend of cognac, spicy cinnamon, and juicy plum, creating a bold and inviting first impression. The heart unveils the elegant, powdery aroma of iris combined with the deep, resinous warmth of myrrh, adding depth and intrigue. Finally, the fragrance rests on a smooth and comforting base of creamy vanilla, rich tonka bean, and soft sandalwood, leaving a long-lasting, captivating trail. Royal Blend is perfect for those who appreciate a fragrance that is both powerful and refined, balancing spice, wood, and sweet sophistication. .

Vulcan Baie is a captivating floral-fruity creation that opens with the sparkling freshness of bergamot and the sweet-tart allure of blackcurrant, elevated by a touch of aromatic rosemary. The heart unfolds with a playful fusion of basil, ripe raspberry, and a crisp vodka accord, adding both brightness and intrigue. Finally, a rich and lingering base of amber, musk, patchouli, sandalwood, and olibanum envelops the senses in warmth and sophistication. A fragrance that is both refreshing and elegant, perfect for those who embrace charm and confidence. .

Discover Atlantis Extrait, a captivating floral-fruity fragrance crafted for women who embrace elegance and freshness. Opening with a burst of juicy orange and refreshing watermelon, this scent unfolds into a delicate heart of creamy coconut and soft white florals. The base lingers with smooth vanilla and rich cocoa, leaving a warm and irresistible trail. Designed to last up to 12 hours, Atlantis Extrait is young, refreshing, and perfect for all seasons. A versatile perfume that transitions seamlessly from daytime brightness to evening sophistication, making it an ideal choice for any occasion. .

A delectable gourmand fragrance that indulges the senses with creamy jasmine, vanilla bean, and coconut milk. The heart unfolds into a rich blend of caramel, amber, and gourmand accords, while the base lingers with musk, tonka beans, and vanilla, creating an irresistibly sweet and comforting aroma. .
